title: Main floor
notes: Scan 5 (kitchen/living, rotated 90 cw by its own edits) is placed so its north wall is collinear with the North End's and its walk-through meets the North End corridor. The shared wall (living room east / Room 2 west) is a standard 4in wall whose west face is the living room's scanned surface; Room 2 takes the rest of the ~15in the scans left between them. The walk-through's north side is redrawn on the corridor's top-wall line. Scan 3 (Front Living Room) shares a standard 4in wall with Room 1A; its north wall is in line with Room 1A's lower 1'6" wall and it projects 2'10" further south (the front of the house jogs). The Front Living Room / Room 1A wall is removed: together they're the Living Room; scan 5's living room is the Dining room.
